task: Triage an inbound support ticket: assign a P1-P4 priority from business impact alone, and extract only the entities the ticket literally states
artifact: a single JSON object carrying priority, entities and confidence
audience: the triage stage of an automated support-ticket pipeline

inputs.name: ticket
inputs.description: the raw inbound support ticket text

success_criteria: priority follows the P1-P4 impact rubric and ignores tone, capitalisation and urgency words
every entity value appears verbatim in the ticket, and anything the ticket does not state is null
a feature request is P4 however urgently it is phrased
confidence is low when the ticket names no product, version or error code
failure_modes: invents a product name such as CRM Platform when the ticket only describes a system
writes a hedge string such as Unknown - not specified into a field instead of null
raises the priority because the ticket is angry, all-caps or says immediately
reports an approximate affected-user count the ticket never gives
